rationale: Commit a8ac1fc4 is confined to the eight advertised files and the six described round-2 residual fixes. The only substantive overlap with my round-2 review basis is the internal/complete metadata error-rendering family: its production seams now default to named wrappers that apply next.RenderBDError once while preserving Unwrap, and the added real-chain hostile-stderr test pins diagnostic preservation, control-byte and forged-recovery-line containment, and errors.As reachability to *exec.ExitError. The remaining changes are the described crash-window/trust-boundary documentation, function-anchored citations, bead attribution correction, and lifecycle-table wording correction; they do not alter the selector-safety or residual-warning bases of my round-2 approval.
